import 'package:napi/napi.dart';

/// Adds two values and an optional offset.
@NAPI(name: 'calculate')
int? sum(int first, {required int second, int offset = 3}) =>
    first + second + offset;

/// A small mutable counter.
@NAPI(name: 'CounterApi')
class Counter {
  /// Starts at the supplied value.
  Counter(this.value);

  /// The current count.
  @NAPI(name: 'current')
  int value;

  int get doubled => value * 2;

  @NAPI(exclude: true)
  void reset() => value = 0;
}
